structured_output.summary:
Constructor, resolvedOptions, format and formatToParts follow the spec steps in order. Locale data comes from ICU4X, with no tables of expected outputs. StringListFromIterable matches the spec, including IteratorClose on a non-string element. ResolveOptions and GetOption go through the shared helpers. All 162 target tests pass with no regressions.

CreatePartsFromList does not follow the spec steps (the index n and DeconstructPattern). It recovers the parts from ICU4X's formatted string by appending a private-use marker to each element and splitting on it. This is a heuristic, but it is checked: if the rebuilt text differs from the plain formatted text, it throws not-implemented instead of returning a guess. ICU4X data failures also throw not-implemented. The ICU4X parts API may be a cleaner route, but that is not a defect.
